scope: Isolated actual application mouse note move, resize, velocity and Shift-marquee cancellation with Escape; exact downloaded projects, selection and Undo checks, then a successful move and Ctrl+Z cancellation of a subsequent drag without undoing that saved move. Two selected notes resize by one beat together with an untouched third note and exact one-step Undo/Redo. Synthetic MIDI; no personal project, input device or model calls.
